SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.CREATEDBYNAME AS PROJUSERNAME, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, B.ORGID, B.ORGNAME, B.TESTORGNAME, B.ENTRUSTORGNAME, B.ENTRUSTORGADDRESS, B.ENTRUSTORGPHONE, B.CREATEDBYNAME AS PROJCREATEDBYNAME, B.REPORTREVIEWERID, B.REPORTREVIEWERNAME, B.REPORTISSUEUSERID, B.REPORTISSUEUSERNAME, B.REPORTEDITUSERNAME, B.REPORTEDITUSERID, B.REPORTISSUETIME, B.CONTRACTNO, B.SAMPLE, B.URGENT, B.SUBPACKAGE, B.COMPLEDATE AS PROJCOMPLEDATE, B.FIRSTISSUEDATETIME AS FIRSTISSUEDATE, B.DELIVERYDATE AS PROJDELIVERYDATE, B.REPORTREMARK, C.ID AS BIZID, C.BIZCATEGORYID, C.BIZCATEGORYNAME, C.FLOWCONTROL, D.REPORTNAME AS TEMPLATENAME, F.MONITORTMPLGROUP, G.REPORTNAME AS QCREPORTNAME, OA.SSGFGSMC, CASE WHEN A.PROCESSSTATUS LIKE 'approve%' THEN (SELECT LISTAGG(TASKNAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY TASKNAME) FROM T_CORE_BPMN_INST I, T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK K WHERE I.ID = K.INSTID AND I.TARGETID = ('T_EMC_REPORT$' || A.ID) ) ELSE '报告编制' END AS TASKNAME_, (SELECT MAX(EXPRESSNO) FROM T_EMC_REPORT_SEND_INFO RSI WHERE A.PROJID = RSI.PROJID) AS EXPRESSNO
,H.ORDERDATE
FROM T_EMC_REPORT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON A.PROJID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY C ON B.BIZCATEGORYID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE D ON A.REPORTCONFIGLINEID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL E ON A.MONITORTMPLID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL_GROUP F ON E.MONITORTMPLGROUPID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE G ON A.QCREPORTLINEID = G.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_OA_ORG OA ON OA.ZZBH = A.CREATEDBYORGID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RL.REPORTID, LISTAGG(DISTINCT TO_CHAR((CASE WHEN (P.SAMPLE = '1') THEN O.SAMPLEBEGINDATE ELSE O.SENDDATE END), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ',' ) AS ORDERDATE FROM T_EMC_ORDER O LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON O.PROJID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_REPORT_LINE RL ON RL.ORDERID = O.ID GROUP BY RL.REPORTID ) H ON H.REPORTID = A.ID
) T
AND T.SSGFGSMC =( SELECT A1.SSGFGSMC FROM T_EMC_OA_ORG A1 LEFT JOIN T_EMC_OA_USER A2 ON A1.ZZBH=A2.SSBM LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER A3 ON A2.YGGH =A3.ID WHERE A3.ID=#{loginUser.id})
AND (T.REPORTEDITUSERID = #{currentUserId} OR T.REPORTEDITUSERID IS NULL )
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJECT TAR_ WHERE TAR_.ID = T.PROJID AND (NVL(TAR_.REPORTREVIEWERID,'') = '' OR TAR_.REPORTREVIEWERID = #{currentUserId}) )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJECT TAR_ WHERE TAR_.ID = T.PROJID AND TAR_.REPORTISSUEUSERID = #{currentUserId} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_REPORT_SEND_INFO TAR_ WHERE TAR_.PROJID = T.PROJID AND TAR_.EXPRESSNO IS NOT NULL )
AND T.REPORTNO NOT LIKE '%G'
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
SELECT A.* FROM T_EMC_REPORT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON A.PROJID = B.ID WHERE A.PROCESSSTATUS = 'draft' AND B.COMPLEDATE <= SYSDATE
